title: Credit Risk Policy: From Default Model to Lending Decision
description: A default model on the seven-table Home Credit dataset (307,511 applications) turned into a cost-based approval policy. 59 features in tested DuckDB SQL, a WoE scorecard benchmarked against LightGBM and CatBoost on time-ordered splits, and an isotonic-calibrated LightGBM at 0.782 test AUC. The chosen cutoff approves 91% of applicants and earns 5.7% more than approve-all, with fairness, reject-inference and A/B sizing checks. Margin and loss assumptions are stated, and the dataset's dates are synthetic, so real drift is not tested.
